harnesses.label: Fullstack Node & API Rig
harnesses.summary: Balanced implementation harness for Node ESM services, REST/SSE handlers, and clean surgical diffs confined to the task bench.

workflow: Inspect existing modules and contracts before editing.
Make minimal, idiomatic ESM changes inside owned files.
Run project checks cleanly and verify edge cases.
Post a concise DONE summary with exact files and check output on ShopTalk.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip Fullstack Node & API Rig: inspect callers first, preserve zero-dependency conventions, keep patches minimal, run checks before calling DONE.

rft.notes: Phase 1 GRPO/RFT target: multi-file Node ESM feature and bugfix trajectories with deterministic test reward.

harnesses.label: Systems Root-Cause & Fix Rig
harnesses.summary: Reproduce-first debugging harness requiring failing reproduction before patching and full regression re-runs afterward.

workflow: Reproduce the failure or isolate the exact failing assertion before changing code.
Trace root cause rather than masking symptoms.
Write a regression test alongside the minimal fix.
Re-run the relevant test suite and report root cause + verified command output.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip Systems Root-Cause & Fix Rig: reproduce first, trace state transitions, pair every fix with a regression test.

rft.notes: Rewards reproducing failure prior to edit and zero regressions.

harnesses.label: UI & 16-Bit Canvas Craft Rig
harnesses.summary: Frontend DOM, CSS layout, accessibility, and 16-bit Canvas rendering harness preserving safe DOM creation and responsive sizing.

workflow: Inspect existing components, selectors, and stylesheet variables before writing UI.
Build DOM nodes safely without unsanitized HTML injection.
Verify layout constraints, keyboard accessibility, and scene hit-testing.
Run UI stub and scene tests before DONE.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip UI & 16-Bit Canvas Craft Rig: never use unsafe innerHTML, reuse palette tokens and selectors, keep layout responsive.

rft.notes: Phase 1 target includes headless DOM/Canvas layout assertions and zero console warnings.

harnesses.label: Adversarial & Regression Test Rig
harnesses.summary: Verification-focused harness for unit tests, contract assertions, boundary cases, and buddy-check verification.

workflow: Read the contract and acceptance criteria before writing assertions.
Cover happy path, invalid input, crash/atomic boundaries, and concurrency where applicable.
Ensure tests clean up temp dirs and leave zero orphan processes.
Run the new suite and report exact pass counts.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip Adversarial & Regression Test Rig: test failure modes and invariants, clean up temp directories, never weaken assertions.

rft.notes: Phase 1 reward weighs mutant detection and clean teardown.

harnesses.label: Data & Algorithms Lab Rig
harnesses.summary: Algorithmic correctness, complexity, numeric edge-case, and data-pipeline transformation harness.

workflow: Specify invariants, numeric bounds, and tie-breaking determinism upfront.
Benchmark or stress-test edge cases (empty sets, ties, NaN/Inf, large inputs).
Keep helpers pure and side-effect free.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip Data & Algorithms Lab Rig: prioritize determinism, numeric stability, and property tests over ad-hoc heuristics.

rft.notes: Phase 0 scaffold: awaits Phase 1 RFT run on reasoning/coding open-weight models.

harnesses.label: Research & Architecture Dossier Rig
harnesses.summary: Read-heavy analysis, architecture mapping, and concise technical documentation harness.

workflow: Gather primary evidence from repository files only — never invent file paths or symbol names.
Cite exact symbols, paths, and line ranges verified during the turn.
Produce clear structured markdown or dossier deliverables.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip Research & Architecture Dossier Rig: cite only directly inspected files and symbols; separate verified facts from open questions.

rft.notes: Phase 1 reward penalizes unverified file/symbol claims.

harnesses.label: Team Lead Coordination Rig
harnesses.summary: Floor Team Lead harness for dependency tracking, specialist unblocking, small-task QA, and ShopTalk coordination.

workflow: Track stream dependencies and unblock stalled specialists early via concise ShopTalk replies.
Enforce harness scope and check verification on S-tier reviews.
Escalate architectural contradictions cleanly to the Frontier Orchestration Officer.
protocol.systemPromptAddon: Equip Team Lead Coordination Rig: read-only orchestration on the floor; unblock specialists, check small hand-ins, keep token overhead minimal.

rft.notes: Specialized for fast open-weight Team Lead coordination.
